metadata.title: When you accidentally ace but only got 2 kills... Valorant math, am I right?
metadata.description:
Wait, I scored 2 kills and called it an ace?
Valorant logic never fails to confuse me.
Watch me pretend this was planned all along.
Click if your highlights are just accidents!

Hit that play button if you love accidental legends!
